identity: A sealed helmet: one dome-shaped shell enclosing the whole head with real clearance (so it hides hair of any length instead of needing a special case to suppress it), with a genuine face-shaped opening cut into the polygon itself - not a tinted overlay, an actual hole, so the real face shows through. A thin glass bezel rings the opening for a visor read.

regions.note: dome shell. A single polygon: 16-gon outer boundary, a seam to a 16-gon inner boundary (the visor opening) traced in reverse, and back - the space between the two rings is the only part filled, so the opening is a true hole, not a covered/tinted patch. Flat-shaded (no auto-crescent) since the seam confuses the crescent fitter on a ring shape.

details.note: visor bezel - same seamed-ring trick, one size smaller, so the true see-through opening is a little tighter than the shell's own hole
